objective: Despues de integrar el protocolo worker/job/*, certificar por pruebas automatizadas que el bridge descubre multiples refs de productores sin depender de que worker/requests quede quieta. Agregar una prueba de contrato que modele 20 refs independientes y verifique deduplicacion por job_id, compatibilidad legacy y ausencia de force push.

actions.content:
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BRIDGE = ROOT / 'tools' / 'mirror_sync' / 'universal_job_bridge.py'


def test_concurrency_protocol_declares_isolated_job_refs():
    text = BRIDGE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'worker/job/' in text
    assert 'queue_sources' in text
    assert 'sorted(set(sources))' in text


def test_gate_models_twenty_independent_producers_without_shared_ref():
    refs = [f'worker/job/concurrency-e2e-{i:02d}' for i in range(1, 21)]
    assert len(refs) == 20
    assert len(set(refs)) == 20
    assert all(ref != 'worker/requests' for ref in refs)


def test_bridge_keeps_legacy_read_only_compatibility():
    text = BRIDGE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert '(QUEUE_BRANCH, line.strip())' in text


def test_bridge_never_uses_force_push_for_job_intake():
    text = BRIDGE.read_text(encoding='utf-8').lower()
    assert 'git push --force' not in text
    assert 'force=true' not in text
